name: Photochemistry & Photophysics
summary: What happens after a molecule absorbs light: excited-state decay, energy and electron transfer, and light-driven reactions.

topics.name: Excited states: singlets, triplets and state diagrams
Radiative and non-radiative decay; quantum yields and lifetimes
Energy transfer: Förster (FRET) and Dexter mechanisms
Photoinduced electron transfer and Marcus theory
Organic photochemistry: [2+2] photocycloaddition, Norrish reactions and photoisomerization
Photochemistry in nature: vision and photosynthesis
Time-resolved techniques: transient absorption and time-correlated single-photon counting
